lines.en: I head for the field with my hoe.
Wet soil clings to my boots.
I crunch over stubble back to the yard.
I bend to check the seedlings.
I count the rows as I go.
The hoe sways on my shoulder.
I step around the compost heap.
I pause at the edge of the field.
My straw hat shades my eyes.
I firm down the loosened soil.
I head for the irrigation channel.
I make many trips in a day.
I stand leaning on the hoe.
I wipe my brow.
I am judging whether those clouds mean rain.
The seedlings are coming along.
I count the irrigation furrows.
I push my hat back.
I wait for the water to come down.
Someone is calling me from afar.
I straighten and stretch my back.
The soil at my feet is damp.
I stand the hoe upright.

lines.zh: 该翻地了,但先歇一会儿
lines.en: Time to turn the soil, but I will rest first.
I have farmed this plot for years.
I can smell the earth.
You are standing on my row.
Mind the seedlings underfoot.
You look like a newcomer.

lines.zh: 你拿的是我家那把锄头。
lines.en: That's my family's hoe you're holding.
Are you here to trade?

lines.zh: 我这儿只有种子和锄头
lines.en: I have only seeds and a hoe.
Do not step on the freshly turned soil.
You do not look like a farmer.
I look you up and down.
It is a busy season; I will keep it short.
If you are here to help, you are welcome.
I wipe the mud off my hands.

lines.zh: 你站在那里正好挡住了风
lines.en: You are blocking the breeze.
We do not often get strangers here.
I nod in greeting.
Those boots of yours are good.

lines.zh: 你要不要看看今年的收成
lines.en: Would you like to see this year's crop?
Careful not to step in the channel.
I step back, propped on the hoe.
My shoulder has gone numb from the blow.
I have a share in the new trades too.
I feel the wound; it is shallow.
I am only a farmer.
I straighten my hat.
My hands are all mud and blood.
I can still stand upright.
This is no great wound.
Do not hit me again.
Seeds? I will take those.
These can be planted.
I take it and look closely.

lines.zh: 这篮子里的东西真新鲜。
lines.en: The stuff in this basket is fresh.
I've never seen this species.
I tip it into my palm.
Good stock; I will keep it.
It is late in the season for this.
I will owe you one.
Any more? Bring some more.
You stepped on my row.
I catch you before you fall.
We knock against the hoe handle.
Careful; that soil was just loosened.
You knocked my hat askew.
Steady; the ground is slick.
I step back to clear the path.
A bump like that is nothing.
There is a stone under your foot.
Stop walking into the field.
I know this is poorly timed.
I lean the hoe against the tree.
The work can wait for tomorrow.

lines.zh: 你坐下来,我给你倒点水
lines.en: Sit; I will pour you some water.

lines.zh: 田里的活,一个人也干得完
lines.en: The field can be worked alone.
But it is better with you here.
We must be back before dark.
This place is quiet, good for talking.
All I know is mending fences.
Pretend I said nothing.
I crouch and gather it up.
These are not seeds.
I weigh it in my hand.
It will serve; into the bag.
I set it aside.
This could serve as a tool.
Who left this in the field?
I will hold it for you for now.
I tuck it into my apron pocket.
I am used to this work.
You have put down your hoe.
I step back one pace.
This is not the look of a helper.
I saw your hand go behind your waist.
There is no one else in the field.

lines.zh: 我不想毁了这一季的收成
lines.en: I do not want to lose this season's crop.
I snatch up the hoe.
You have crushed three seedlings.
This village is not large.
One shout and people will come.
I take my stand on the ridge.
You had better think it through.
I only know how to shoo birds off crops.
But I will not run.
Hoe in hand, I tend this field.
There is still room to talk.
I carry my hoe out to the field.
The hoe is held in both hands.
You are on my land.

lines.zh: 我比地里的人都熟悉这儿
lines.en: I know this place better than anyone.
I won't be the first to swing.
The storehouse is behind me.
I stop once I reach the doorway.
The soil under you is soft.
My sickle only turns after you.
One more step and I will move.
I grip the tool in my hands.
The hoe is heavier than I thought.
I keep my eyes off yours.
Listen; the dogs in the village are barking.
They will all come.
I only need to hold the door.
One step closer and I swing the hoe.
The time has come.
The hoe sweeps across.
I strike your knee guard.
There is no finesse in this blow.

lines.zh: 我退回来,两手还握着柄
lines.en: I pull back, still gripping the handle.
You nearly crushed my seedlings.
I shove you once.
Clods of earth spray over us both.
My arms ache from swinging.
These are farm hands.
They were not trained for this.
I guard the door behind me.
The hoe comes down heavy.
The village will hear.
I raise the hoe upright.
I do not want to fight more.
There is still a harvest to bring in.

lines.zh: 我扛着锄头从田埂上过来
lines.en: I come along the ridge with my hoe.
My hat is pulled low.
I stop at the edge of the field.
There is still mud on my boots.
The channel sounds in the distance.
It's getting dark; time to quit.
There is plenty of work today.
First I roll up my sleeves.
The seedlings have just two leaves.
I bend to right one of them.
Everyone in the village knows me.
I glance your way.
This land has someone tending it.
I usually keep quiet.
But no one tramples my seedlings.
If you stay, mind your manners.
It will be dark soon.
I need to bring the water through.
My straw hat caught first.
I land in the furrow.
The channel is deeper than I thought.

lines.zh: 土被掀起来,我埋在下面
lines.en: The earth erupts and buries me.
Something lodges in my leg.
That light leaves me dizzy.

lines.zh: 这一季收成不好,我也饿
lines.en: A poor harvest, and I am hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打在我举起的锄头上
lines.en: Lightning strikes my raised hoe.
There is no soil to farm here.
